{{Conjecture|legends}}
The '''wife''' of the [[Epicanthix]] [[Dux Pike]] was a [[Bunduki/Legends|Bunduki]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] and the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of [[Twin/Legends|twin]] sisters [[Zan Pike|Zan]] and [[Zu Pike]].<ref name="RES">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref> The twins' mother was responsible for sending them to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bunduki/Legends|Bunduki]], where the girls learned the [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial art]] known as [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]].<ref name="SotES">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
